thread:
alex chen: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR for the SDK snippet changes that need to land before the v1.9 release cutoff. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1789

maria gonzalez: Thanks. What's the blocker? CI failing or reviewer bandwidth?

alex chen: CI preview failing on the sidebar include path; locally it looks fine. Also want to coordinate merge timing with the feature-flag rollout scheduled in the next deploy window.

sam li: I can take a look at the preview error now. If it's just the include path, might be a path mismatch after the versioned site move.

jen park: FYI the release cutoff is tomorrow 11:00 PT. Anything merged after that risks not being in the release snapshots.

patrick o'neil: Can we fast-follow: merge docs only if the feature flag is gated? We should avoid publishing the migration steps before the FF is flipped.

alex chen: Good point. The PR includes a short migration guide that mentions the FF. We could wrap that section in a callout behind a FIXME note until the flag is live.

maria gonzalez: Another option: put migration guide under /unreleased/ and add a banner pointing to it — keeps it out of stable nav while reviewers confirm wording.

sam li: Update: preview error is from the new Sphinx include directive. Quick fix: change ".. include:: /includes/sdk-snippet.md" to a relative path. I'll push a fix in 10m.

docs-bot: CI preview build queued — build 4621. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/build/4621

jen park: If Sam's fix makes preview green, can we schedule merge for this afternoon? We have a late merge window at 16:30 PT that still lands before cutoff for the docs pipeline.

patrick o'neil: I can act as reviewer at 16:15 PT. If CI green and no unresolved comments, I can approve and merge into the release branch.

alex chen: Thanks Patrick — I pushed Sam's path fix. Also removed the explicit FF mention and added a short note linking to feature-flag docs instead.

sam li: Preview passed: build 4624 succeeded. Seems correct.

deploy-bot: Heads-up — scheduled deploy for docs staging at 16:30 PT. Canary window 30m.

jen park: Sounds good. Patrick, please merge to branch release/v1.9 and create a follow-up to re-enable the explicit migration snippet after FF flip.

patrick o'neil: Will do. If anyone sees wording issues after I merge, open a small PR — we'll cut a docs-only patch.

alex chen: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Leaving a note in the PR: "merge by 16:45 PT to ensure inclusion in v1.9 docs snapshot." :thumbsup:

maria gonzalez: I'll queue a short QA pass on the preview once merged, just to sanity-check links and the versioned nav.

sam li: One small checklist addition for future: add a docs CI check that fails on absolute include paths. Saved us a lunch panic.

alex chen: Agreed. I'll open an issue to add that rule.

jen park: Great work team — thanks for coordinating.

patrick o'neil: Merged at 1712102700. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:

alex chen: Confirmed the PR is in release/v1.9. Thanks everyone!
